## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The README still documents the old 30-second default, so users reading it get the wrong timeout; fix the stale README line before merge.

## Changes
The pull request raises `DEFAULT_TIMEOUT` in `app/cli.py` from 30 to 60 seconds and updates the default-value assertion in `tests/test_cli.py`. It also adds a one-line root file, `review.txt`.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/cli.py:3 — comments — Update the README's 30-second timeout statement — After this change, a user who runs the tool without `--timeout` gets a 60-second timeout. However, `README.md:3` still says "Requests time out after 30 seconds unless you pass `--timeout SECONDS`." — Users and operators who rely on the README will expect requests to fail at 30 seconds and may tune retries or alerts wrongly. — Fix: Change `README.md:3` to say 60 seconds.
